name: chicken-dinner-feed
description: Real-time bridge between the PUBG Mobile PCOB API and broadcast software: ingests live match data and renders configurable animated overlays.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @cdf/shared && concurrently -n shared,backend,frontend -c gray,blue,magenta "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cdf/shared && npm run build -w @cdf/backend && npm run build -w @cdf/frontend
